# Everything about the thirst quencher / Thirst Zapper (Nuka World on Tour)

![All about the thirst quencher / Thirst Zapper (Nuka World on Tour)](/uploads/79_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The **Thirst Zapper** is probably familiar to many who have played **Fallout 4**. Fallout 4 already had the thirst quencher in “**Nuka World**”. Of course, he also appears in the Nuka World on Tour update in **Fallout 76**.

The basic version of the thirst quencher is a toy water gun that basically doesn't do any damage. At level 50 she does 12 damage without mods.

![](/uploads/316082080-1528846897617098-8607865125887415762-n.jpg)

Things get interesting with the Nuka Cola mods.

## Where do you get the thirst quencher?

After the update on December 6th, 2022, you will find a new location west of Lewisburg: Nuka World Tour. There are terminals in the Nuka Cade tent where you can see your **Nuka Cade points** and choose rewards for the points. You already know this type of terminal from various places in Appalachia, e.g. Campden Park (Mr. Fuzzy Marken), the Burning Mine or Watoga High School.

At this terminal you can get the thirst quencher as a weapon at price level 3 for **6000 Nuka Cade points**. (The terminal says “thirst killer” instead of “thirst quencher”)

You can get the plan for the mods "**Plan: Weaponized Nuka-Cola Formulas**" at price level 5 for **20,000 Nuka Cade points**.

So you need a total of 26,000 Nuka Cade points to get the basic version of the weapon with the usable mods. You can get Nuka Cade points at Nuka World Events and in Cappy's Nuka Cade tent at the games.

You learn the **plan** of the weapon itself by scrapping a non-legendary thirst quencher. The chance of learning the plan while scrapping is 25%. I scrapped 3 thirst quenchers until I learned the plan. You can then find the thirst quencher at the **Weapon Workbench** under **Energy Weapons** for crafting at level 1/5/10/20/30/40/50.

You can watch how you can get Nuka Cade points regardless of the events in this YouTube video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lUV1Qytpkow

![](/uploads/fallout76-18.11.2022-21-42-34.jpg)

## Legendary thirst quencher

Things get interesting when you roll the thirst quencher at the workbench with legendary effects. The effects are currently somewhat limited to the 2nd and 3rd stars. 

In the live version, the thirst quencher can now drop with the following legendary perks *:

1. legendary effect:

- Anti-armor
- Instigating
- Aristocrat
- Bloodstained
- The killer
- The Berserker
- The fanatic
- The executioner
- The exterminator
- The Ghoul Slayer
- The gourmet
- The hunter
- The junkie
- Of the mutant
- The Mutant Slayer
- The problem solver
- Of the heavyweight
- Of the oppressor
- Of the vampire
- Nocturnal
- Raging

2. legendary effect:

- +50% body part damage (crippling)
- +50% melee damage (Basher's)
- Regenerates AP (Inertial) with every kill
- Critical hits in VATS deal +50% more damage (Lucky)
- +25% damage when aiming (Hitman's)
- +50% VATS hit chance (VATS Enhanced)

3. legendary effect:

- +1 mobility (agility)
- Breaks 50% slower (Durability)
- 90% weight reduced (Lightweight)
- VATS critical hit bar fills 15% faster (Lucky)
- Faster movement when aiming (Nimble)
- 25% less VATS action point costs (VATS Enhanced)
- +250 damage resistance when reloading (Resilent)
- +50 damage resistance when aiming (Steadfast)

**Additional legendary effects are currently not possible.**

After the 2nd roll I had this one:
![](/uploads/fallout76-18.11.2022-20-30-37.jpg)

## Which thirst quencher mods are there?

There are 3 Nuka Cola mods included in the Weaponized Nuka Cola Formulas plan:

- Nuka-Cherry Rifle / Nuka-Cherry Gun
- Nuka-Cola wt
